```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
rownames(mouse) = mouse[['Xenium']]@meta.data$gene_name
markers = list(
  "B cell"      = c("Cd79a", "Cd79b", "Cd19", "Pax5", "Ebf1", "Vpreb1", "Ms4a1"),
  "DC"          = c("Xcr1", "Clec9a", "Cd209a", "H2-Ab1", "Siglech", "Flt3"),
  "Erythroid"   = c("Klf1", "Gata1", "Gypa", "Car1", "Car2", "Alas2", "Slc4a1"),
  "Granulocyte" = c("S100a8", "S100a9", "Ltf", "Camp", "Ngp", "Ly6g", "Mpo", "Elane"),
  "HSPC"        = c("Kit", "Procr", "Hlf", "Mecom", "Cd34", "Meis1"),
  "Mac"         = c("Adgre1", "C1qa", "C1qb", "Mrc1", "Hmox1", "Spic"),
  "Mast"        = c("Cpa3", "Cma1", "Mcpt4", "Tpsb2", "Fcer1a"),
  "MkP"         = c("Pf4", "Itga2b", "Gp9", "Gp1bb", "Ppbp"),
  "Monocyte"    = c("Ly6c2", "Ccr2", "Csf1r", "Lyz2", "Ms4a6c", "F13a1"),
  "MSC"         = c("Lepr", "Cxcl12", "Kitl", "Adipoq", "Ebf3", "Angpt1"),
  "NK/ILC"      = c("Nkg7", "Ncr1", "Klrb1c", "Gzma", "Prf1", "Klrd1"),
  "Plasma"      = c("Jchain", "Sdc1", "Xbp1", "Prdm1", "Tnfrsf17"),
  "T cell"      = c("Cd3e", "Cd3g", "Cd2", "Trbc2", "Cd4", "Cd8a", "Lck")
)

markers = lapply(markers, intersect, rownames(mouse))
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = "celltype_singleR") + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = "celltype_seurat") + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = "celltype_singleR_cross") + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = "celltype_seurat_cross") + RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse, features = markers, group.by = "celltype") + RotatedAxis()

ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype', axes = TRUE)
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_seurat')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_singleR')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_seurat_cross')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_singleR_cross')
```

# Dissect

```{r}
coords = GetTissueCoordinates(mouse)   # has its own `cell` column; row order need not match colnames(mouse)
coords$celltype = mouse$celltype[match(coords$cell, colnames(mouse))]
p = plot_ly(
  coords,
  x = ~x,
  y = ~y,
  color = ~celltype,
  type = "scattergl",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 3),
  text = ~paste0(
    "x: ", x,
    "<br>y: ", y
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) |>
  layout(
    dragmode = "drawclosedpath",
    newshape = list(line = list(width = 2))
  ) |>
  config(
    modeBarButtonsToAdd = c(
      "drawclosedpath",
      "eraseshape"
    )
  )

p

# option A: right femur marrow cavity only (excludes epiphyses / growth-plate
# cartilage and cortical stroma; chosen from the hematopoietic bin map)
xmin = 500;  xmax = 4750
ymin = 2500; ymax = 3500

ggplot(coords, aes(x, y, color = celltype)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.025) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax,
           fill = NA, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
  coord_fixed() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)))
```

```{r}
coords$keep = coords$y >= ymin & coords$y <= ymax &
  coords$x >= xmin & coords$x <= xmax

mouse_subset = mouse |> 
  subset(cells = coords$cell[coords$keep])

SaveSeuratRds(mouse_subset, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_subset_annotated.rds')

as.anndata(mouse_subset, file_path = 'data/02_annotated_data/',
           file_name = '02_mouse_subset_annotated', assay = 'Xenium',
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```
